code_consumers.text: protected InteractionResult mobInteract(Player p,InteractionHand h){if(level().isClientSide)return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;Knowledge.award(p,"meet_vodyanoy");ItemStack s=p.getItemInHand(h);Item i=s.getItem();if(i!=Items.BREAD&&i!=ModItems.KARAVAI.get()&&i!=ModItems.PEARL_FRAGMENT.get())return InteractionResult.PASS;String key=p.getStringUUID();if(!relations.contains(key)&&relations.getAllKeys().size()>=64)return InteractionResult.FAIL;CompoundTag n=relations.getCompound(key);long now=level().getGameTime();if(now<n.getLong("GiftReady"))return InteractionResult.FAIL;n.putInt("Rep",Math.min(100,n.getInt("Rep")+10));n.putLong("GiftReady",now+1200);relations.put(key,n);if(!p.isCreative())s.shrink(1);friend=p.getUUID();friendUntil=now+1200;if(getTarget()==p)setTarget(null);state(0);if(n.getInt("Rep")>=40&&!n.getBoolean("DepthClue")){n.putBoolean("DepthClue",true);relations.put(key,n);spawnAtLocation(ModItems.ANCIENT_WATER_SIGN.get());Knowledge.award(p,"depth_clue");}if(n.getInt("Rep")>=20){p.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.LUCK,1800,0));if(random.nextInt(4)==0)spawnAtLocation(ModItems.PEARL_FRAGMENT.get());}voice("ambient",.5F);return InteractionResult.CONSUME;}

public static ItemStack reward(int i){return switch(i){case 0,7->new ItemStack(Quest185Content.WARD.get());case 2->new ItemStack(Quest185Content.TRACKER.get());case 5->ItemStack.EMPTY;case 6->new ItemStack(PolozContent.DUST.get(),3);case 8->new ItemStack(Quest185Content.CALL.get());default->ItemStack.EMPTY;};}

public static boolean claim(ServerPlayer p,int i){if(i<0||i>=9||status(p,i)!=Quest185State.Status.READY)return false;var n=data(p);if(i==1&&!spend(p,PolozContent.DUST.get(),3))return false;if(i==2&&trophies(p)){n.putBoolean("EyeShown",true);n.putBoolean("TrophiesVerified",true);}if(!Quest185State.claim(n,i))return false;

public static CompoundTag snapshot(ServerPlayer p){migrate(p);var n=data(p);var out=new CompoundTag();out.putBoolean("IntroDone",n.getBoolean("IntroDone"));out.putBoolean("Invitation",n.getBoolean("Invitation"));out.putBoolean("Cleansing",n.getBoolean("Cleansing"));out.putBoolean("EyeReady",eyeReady(p));out.putBoolean("EarthClaimed",n.getBoolean("EarthRestorationRewardClaimed"));out.putInt("EarthCount",CleansingLessons.get(p.serverLevel()).count(p.getUUID()));out.putBoolean("EarthVirtual",CleansingLessons.get(p.serverLevel()).virtual(p.getUUID()));out.putBoolean("HutKnown",n.contains("Hut"));if(n.contains("Hut"))out.putLong("Hut",n.getLong("Hut"));out.putInt("Kills",n.getInt("MorKills"));out.putInt("Dust",Runes.inventoryCount(p,PolozContent.DUST.get()));out.putBoolean("Likho",n.getBoolean("Likho"));out.putBoolean("Ovinnik",n.getBoolean("Ovinnik"));out.putBoolean("Poloz",n.getBoolean("Poloz"));var stages=new ListTag();for(int i=0;i<9;i++){var q=new CompoundTag();q.putString("Id",Quest185State.IDS[i]);q.putString("Status",status(p,i).name());q.putBoolean("Pending",Quest185State.quest(n,i).contains("Pending"));q.putInt("Progress",i==0?n.getInt("MorKills"):i==1?Runes.inventoryCount(p,PolozContent.DUST.get()):i==7?n.getInt("BasicKills")-Quest185State.quest(n,i).getInt("StartKills"):i==8?Quest185State.quest(n,i).getInt("TrainingKills"):0);stages.add(q);}out.put("Stages",stages);out.putInt("WolfTrust",wolfTrust(p));return out;}
